title: Restore the Agent Handoff Surface the Merge Dropped
description:
The board-redesign merge (e842ce6) took the redesigned branch's MapScreen and map route wholesale and silently dropped two behaviours main had shipped and reviewed. AgentHandoff stayed imported and stopped being rendered, so a person opening a map with nobody attached saw only 'No agent attached' and an unexplained r14 badge - no start prompt, no MCP command, no route out; and the dev agent panel went back to rendering on every npm run dev session, the exact bug e3673c1 fixed, where an agent driving the browser finds 'Run the demo sequence' and writes invented nodes onto a real map. Both are restored: the band mounts unwrapped between the header and the workspace with dense on the finished-plan phase, the route passes brief through so hasBrief picks the right entry point, the panel is gated on the already-tested agentPanelRequested (?agentPanel=1, production floor underneath), the r{revision} badge is deleted from the header, and the JustArrived fixture's dead mapId/seedIdea fields are wired through so that scenario stops capturing the same frame as NoAgent.

Why it was invisible: every existing test rendered AgentHandoff and agentPanelRequested in ISOLATION, and all of them passed against the broken screen. This cycle adds the missing composition-level assertions - MapScreen.render.test.tsx (band mounted / absent / read_brief / read_map) and AgentStatus.render.test.tsx (the badge stays gone in both bridge states) - and prove-red confirms 5 of the 6 go red with the fix reverted, the sixth being a deliberate survival guard. Three screen-level scenarios were added for the same reason (mapscreen-frombrief, mapscreen-reattach, mapscreen-summaryreattach), and 28 stale captures were recaptured; the scenario literally named 'Nobody has picked this up yet' had been capturing a bare board and now shows the band saying so.

SCOPE VERDICT. Delivered: the full plan - band restored, brief passed through, ?agentPanel=1 gate reconnected, revision badge removed, JustArrived fixture rewired, and the reproduction test the plan specified. All 10 project deliverables were already resolved before this cycle (9 delivered; 1, the assist-track registering work, deferred earlier by the user) and this cycle deferred none of them. No extractions were made because none were warranted - the change composes an existing component and moves logic INTO an already-extracted predicate.

DEFERRED FINDINGS (both pre-existing, both surfaced rather than fixed here, neither introduced by this change): (1) HandoffReattach's dense strip overflows at Tablet width - the MCP command truncates and its copy button lands off-frame; the committed handoffreattach-dense screenshot taken before this session shows the identical clipping, and mapscreen-summaryreattach is simply the first frame to show it in composition. Fixing it means reworking that component's dense layout and recapturing its four scenarios. (2) AgentStatus renders '1 tools' - the headline interpolates tools.length with no pluralisation, and the coverage plan flags tools=one as planned-but-uncovered. Both were reported to the user at the final gate and left as follow-up rather than widening this cycle.
